question: What happens to all that pollution when it merges into the Gaṅgā?
premises: Polluted substances may flow into the Gaṅgā
The Gaṅgā is regarded as purifying
Merging changes the status of what was polluted
inference: When all merges into the Gaṅgā, its polluted status is no longer held in the same way.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and continues into the next verse
plain_english: O goddess, when all of that has merged into the Gaṅgā.
